description: A hole in the upper track, over a lower track that runs the whole length. Frames 0-19 and 40-59 are blue from the upper clips; frames 20-39 must be the red bed showing through, not black. The sampled frames sit either side of both edges of the hole. A gap that contributed an opaque black layer instead of no layer would black out the bed and pass every single-track fixture in the suite.
